title: White Bean Patties
subtitle: in a lemony pea sauce
description: Baked white bean and zucchini patties simmered in a lemony coriander and pea sauce. Cook the patties in the sauce only just before serving, and keep them separate until then.

steps.text: Make the sauce: heat 6 tablespoons olive oil in a low, wide pot, add the finely chopped onion and sliced garlic and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until translucent, stirring occasionally.

Add half the peas, half the lemon juice and the remaining sauce ingredients (chopped coriander, chilli, water, paprika, turmeric, salt and pepper) and bring to the boil. Lower the heat and simmer uncovered for 1 1/2 hours.

Make the patties: heat 4 tablespoons olive oil in a wide pan, add the grated zucchini and fry on medium heat for about 5 minutes until it starts to release liquid. Transfer to a sieve over a bowl, cool to room temperature, then squeeze out the excess liquid and place in a clean bowl.

Soak the ground flaxseed in 3 tablespoons water for 5 minutes. Roughly mash the beans, then add the lemon zest, parsley, flax mixture, breadcrumbs, nutritional yeast, salt, pepper and chilli to the zucchini and mix until even. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a tray with baking paper. Shape the mixture into ping-pong-sized balls, place on the tray and drizzle with the remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil. Bake for 15 minutes, turn and bake for 15 more minutes until firm and browned.
Just before serving, add the remaining peas and lemon juice to the sauce, slide in the patties and simmer together for 20 minutes. Serve hot in bowls, topped with chopped coriander.
